title: Pure Metalfoes
summary: Metalfoes cards only, with generic Links and staples. Metalfoes are FIRE Psychic Pendulums, mostly Normal Monsters, with Scales of 1 and 8. Each Metalfoes Scale destroys another face-up card you control to Set a Metalfoes Spell/Trap from the Deck, which also feeds the deck's "when destroyed" effects. Metalfoes Fusion and its variants make Metalfoes Fusion Monsters. Metalfoes Counter and Raremetalfoes Bismugear turn their own destruction into new monsters. The 2021 cards lead. Parametalfoes Fusion can use a face-up Pendulum from the Extra Deck as material. Parametalfoes Melcaster returns a face-up Metalfoes Pendulum from the Extra Deck when destroyed. Metalfoes Vanisher destroys two of your cards to summon itself and banish a monster. Parametalfoes Azortless destroys their card when summoned, and again from the Pendulum Zone whenever a Metalfoes is destroyed.
